title: Kissed Tangy Algerian Prawns Tagine
description: A comforting Algerian dish featuring raw king prawns, slow-cooked in a tangy and cheesy sauce, perfect for a cold winter night, and prepared in an ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly way.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large clay or ceramic tagine or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Stir in the ground cumin, ground coriander, and cayenne pepper and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomato paste and cook, stirring constantly, for 2 minutes.
Add the halved cherry tomatoes, salt, and pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the raw king prawns and stir to combine with the sauce.
Cover the tagine or Dutch oven and transfer it to the oven.
Bake, covered, at 300 degrees Fahrenheit for 20 minutes.
Remove the tagine or Dutch oven from the oven and stir in the crumbled feta cheese.
Return the tagine or Dutch oven to the oven and bake, uncovered, for an additional 5 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
